title: Chalktastic Liquid Chalk Markers Set of 8 Washable Erasable Chalk Pens for Windows Blackboards Glass & Cars
features: Ideal for decorating any window, bistro board, or sign—these erasable chalkboard markers also work on glass, ceramic, whiteboards, and more.
Colored chalk power without the dusty mess—high-quality concentrated ink for non-porous surfaces.
Reversible bullet and chisel tip so you can switch between fine lines and broader strokes.
Washable, non-toxic, and odorless—wipe away with a damp cloth for a smear-free clean.
Practical for family DIY crafts, seasonal window decorating, and gift-ready creative kits.
